about.cta.copy.en: We usually reply within a day.

about.deliver.1.copy.id: Foto selesai dalam tiga minggu, film dalam enam minggu. Kalau butuh teaser pendek lebih cepat, bilang sebelum shooting supaya editingnya kami atur dari awal.
about.deliver.1.copy.en: Photos are ready in three weeks and the film in six. If you need a short teaser sooner than that, say so before the shoot and we will plan the edit around it.

about.deliver.2.copy.id: Semuanya masuk ke folder Google Drive yang jadi milik kamu: foto resolusi penuh, film yang sudah di-grading, dan file kamera kalau kamu mau.
about.deliver.2.copy.en: Everything goes into a Google Drive folder that stays yours: full resolution photos, the graded film, and the camera files if you want them.

about.deliver.3.copy.id: Satu putaran revisi film sudah termasuk. Kirim timecode-nya, kami kerjakan sekali jalan.
about.deliver.3.copy.en: One round of changes on the film is included. Send us the timecodes and we work through them in a single pass.

about.deliver.title.id: Apa yang kamu dapat, dan kapan.

about.hero.copy.id: MellogangVisuals adalah tim foto dan video yang berbasis di Denpasar. Sebagian besar kerjaan kami pernikahan dan acara di sekitar Bali, ditambah proyek korporat dan destinasi kalau briefnya cocok.
about.hero.copy.en: MellogangVisuals is a photo and video team based in Denpasar. Most of our work is weddings and events around Bali, plus corporate and destination projects when the brief fits.

about.hero.title.id: Siapa kami, dan bagaimana booking jalan.
about.hero.title.en: Who we are, and how a booking runs.

about.process.copy1.id: Kamu kirim tanggal dan lokasinya. Kami cek di kalender, lalu balas: kosong atau tidak, berapa orang yang datang, dan kisaran harga untuk acara seperti itu.
about.process.copy1.en: You send a date and a location. We check it against the calendar and reply with whether it is open, how many of us would come, and a price range for that kind of day.

about.process.copy2.id: Kalau cocok, tanggalnya kami tahan dengan deposit. Seminggu sebelum shooting kami kirim rundown yang kami pakai, biar bisa kamu koreksi.
about.process.copy2.en: If it works, a deposit holds the date. A week before the shoot we send you the running order we will be working from, so you can correct it.

about.process.image.alt.id: Pengantin perempuan bermahkota emas menatap kamera saat pengantin lelaki mendekat, dibingkai pintu kayu berukir.
about.process.image.alt.en: Bride in a gold headdress looking at the camera while the groom leans in, framed by a carved wooden doorway.

about.process.title.id: Kami cek kalender dulu sebelum bahas yang lain.
about.process.title.en: We check the calendar before we talk about anything else.

about.team.atar.candid.alt.id: Atar pakai hoodie dan masker, duduk di ambang pintu kena sinar matahari sore.
about.team.atar.candid.alt.en: Atar in a hoodie and face mask, sitting in a doorway in the afternoon sun.

about.team.atar.image.alt.id: Atar berjas gelap dan berdasi, difoto dengan latar biru studio.
about.team.atar.image.alt.en: Atar in a dark suit and tie, photographed against a blue studio backdrop.

about.team.darmadi.candid.alt.id: Darmadi di depan sebuah toko, pakai jaket cokelat dan kemeja putih.
about.team.darmadi.candid.alt.en: Darmadi outside a shopfront in a brown jacket and white shirt.

about.team.darmadi.image.alt.id: Darmadi mengolah tanah dengan cangkul saat senja, pohon kelapa dan awan di belakangnya.
about.team.darmadi.image.alt.en: Darmadi working a hoe through a field at dusk, palms and cloud behind him.

about.team.note.id: Arahkan kursor ke fotonya, foto satunya kelihatan lewat situ. Klik untuk balik ke foto itu.
about.team.note.en: Move the cursor over a photo and the other one shows through. Click to flip to it.

about.team.title.id: Kamu akan berhadapan dengan salah satu dari kami.
about.team.title.en: You will be dealing with one of these two.

book.form.date.hint.id: Kalau masih bisa geser, tulis tanggal yang paling dekat.
book.form.date.hint.en: If it can still move, put the closest date.

book.form.error.date.id: Isi tanggalnya dulu supaya bisa kami cek.
book.form.error.date.en: Add a date so we can check it.

book.form.error.name.id: Isi namanya supaya kami tahu balas ke siapa.
book.form.error.name.en: Add a name so we know who we are replying to.

book.form.notes.label.id: Hal lain yang perlu kami tahu

book.form.notes.placeholder.id: Jumlah tamu, jam mulai, ada lokasi kedua atau tidak.
book.form.notes.placeholder.en: Guest count, start time, whether there is a second location.

book.hero.copy.id: Isi formnya, WhatsApp langsung terbuka dengan detail yang kamu tulis. Tidak ada data yang disimpan di halaman ini.
book.hero.copy.en: Fill this in and WhatsApp opens with your details already written out. Nothing is stored on this page.

book.preview.direct.en: Or message us without the form

book.preview.note.id: Form ini tidak menyimpan apa pun. Isinya jadi pesan WhatsApp yang bisa kamu baca dulu sebelum dikirim.
book.preview.note.en: This form saves nothing. It writes a WhatsApp message you can read before you send it.

book.wa.template.id: Halo MellogangVisuals, saya {name}. Mau cek tanggal {date} kosong atau tidak untuk {type} di {location}.{notes}
book.wa.template.en: Hello MellogangVisuals. I am {name}. I would like to check whether {date} is open for {type} at {location}.{notes}

footer.hours.id: Pesan kami baca antara jam 9 pagi sampai 9 malam WITA.
footer.hours.en: We read messages between 9am and 9pm WITA.

footer.tagline.id: Foto dan video, berbasis di Denpasar. Kami shooting di seluruh Bali dan berangkat lebih jauh kalau proyeknya memang butuh.
footer.tagline.en: Photo and video, based in Denpasar. We shoot across Bali and travel further when a project needs it.

home.about.copy.id: MellogangVisuals adalah tim foto dan video yang berbasis di Denpasar. Sebagian besar kerjaan kami pernikahan dan acara di sekitar Bali, ditambah proyek korporat dan destinasi kalau briefnya cocok.
home.about.copy.en: MellogangVisuals is a photo and video team based in Denpasar. Most of our work is weddings and events around Bali, plus corporate and destination projects when the brief fits.

home.about.image.alt.id: Foto udara petak ladang berteras dan camp di lereng Candikuning, Tabanan, dengan kabut turun dari punggung bukit.
home.about.image.alt.en: Aerial view of terraced farm plots and a hillside camp at Candikuning, Tabanan, with mist coming off the ridge.

home.about.title.en: The team is based in Denpasar.

home.cta.copy.id: Kirim ke kami sekalian gambaran acaranya. Biasanya kami balas dalam sehari.
home.cta.copy.en: Send it over with a rough idea of the day. We usually reply within a day.

home.hero.copy.id: Tim kecil, produksi lengkap, dari obrolan pertama sampai file terakhir. Kirim tanggalnya, kami langsung kabari kosong atau tidak.
home.hero.copy.en: Small crew, full production, from the first call to the final file. Send us a date and we will tell you straight away whether it is open.

home.hero.image.alt.id: Pengantin perempuan bermahkota emas Bali dan pengantin lelaki berudeng duduk berdampingan di bale berhias bunga.
home.hero.image.alt.en: Bride in a gold Balinese headdress and groom in an udeng seated together at a flower-decorated pavilion.

home.hero.title.id: Foto dan video pernikahan, acara, dan brand di Bali.
home.hero.title.en: Wedding, event and brand shoots in Bali.

home.works.note.id: Lima proyek di sini. Buka satu untuk menonton filmnya dan frame yang kami simpan.
home.works.note.en: Five projects here. Open one to watch the film and the frames we kept.

home.works.title.en: Some of what we have shot

home.works.viewall.en: See the rest of the work

portfolio.cta.copy.id: Sebut tanggal dan lokasinya. Kami balas soal ketersediaan dulu.
portfolio.cta.copy.en: Tell us the date and the location. We reply with availability first.

portfolio.cta.title.en: Check whether your date is open.

portfolio.empty.id: Belum ada proyek di filter ini.
portfolio.empty.en: No projects under this filter yet.

portfolio.hero.copy.id: Tidak semua yang kami shooting boleh dipublikasikan. Minta saja, nanti kami kirim contoh lain yang mirip acaramu. Buka satu proyek untuk menonton filmnya dan melihat frame-nya.
portfolio.hero.copy.en: Not everything we shoot gets published. Ask us and we will send more from a shoot like yours. Open a project to watch the film and look through the frames.

portfolio.hero.title.en: The projects we can show publicly.

project.film.none.id: Proyek ini tidak ada filmnya. Fotonya ada di bawah, set lengkapnya di tautan sumber.
project.film.none.en: No film for this project. The stills are below and the full set is on the source link.
